library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

2 Virginia Beach

Gather spatial data for Virginia Beach, Virginia

2.1 Static map

va_income_sf = get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001", # income variable
  state = "VA",
  year = 2023,
  geometry = T
  )

2.2 Interactive map

mapview(
  va_income_sf,
  zcol = "estimate"
)
dc_income_sf = get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001", # income variable
  state = "DC",
  year = 2024,
  geometry = T
  )
## Getting data from the 2020-2024 5-year ACS
## Downloading feature geometry from the Census website.  To cache shapefiles for use in future sessions, set `options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)`.
##   |                                                                              |                                                                      |   0%  |                                                                              |=========================                                             |  35%  |                                                                              |==============================================================        |  88%  |                                                                              |======================================================================| 100%
plot(dc_income_sf['estimate'])

mapview(
  dc_income_sf,
  zcol = "estimate"
)
